chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Do not engage in intercourse on a ship.

key_terms.عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: peace be upon him; honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: Is intercourse disliked while traveling on a ship in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling of dislike regarding intercourse on a ship. It appears in a chapter concerning times and circumstances in which intercourse is discouraged, indicating an etiquette-based legal teaching within family life.
